worked_solution:
The period of $y=\operatorname{csc}⁡x$ is $2\pi .$ Therefore, for integer $n$ we have

$$
\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+2n\pi ).
$$

Substituting $n=6$ into the right-hand-side of the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+2\cdot 6\cdot \pi )=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+12\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\operatorname{csc}⁡x=3,$ then $\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+12\pi )=3.$

Finally, then

$$
5\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+12\pi )=5\cdot 3=15.
$$
